summary_markdown:
The team confirmed receipt of all necessary parts after reviewing the guide and hardware with technicians. Several physical modifications were requested for the Lidar sensor setup:

*   **Cable Extension:** The current black connection box (containing USB and Lidar sensor connectors) was unexpected. The sensor cable length is significantly shorter than 5M, and the 5m extension starts after a large box. A request was made to extend the cable *before* converting the signal to USB and move the associated box further back.
*   **Housing Paint:** The outer housing of the Lidar sensor needs painting to match existing assets. Only the exterior will be painted; the inner parts and shiny sensor components will remain covered.
decisions: The team confirmed receipt of all necessary hardware parts.
action_items: Determine feasibility of extending the lidar cable before USB signal conversion and relocating the connection box.
Plan for painting the outer housing of the Lidar sensor to match facility assets.
